notes.title: V1.0.005 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/4a55135323e3527a4601c6614ab0a8a9aac04938.jpg

V1.0.005 Patch Notes

🌿 Fixes and Improvements  
We’ve been hard at work squashing bugs that hindered your cozy elven city-building experience. The interface is now more responsive, and some pesky issues affecting the economy and citizen movement have vanished into oblivion (if you know, you know).  

Coming Soon: Revolutionary Worker Priority System!  
Get ready for one of the most user-friendly mechanics in city-building games — dynamic elf employment allocation! You’ll be able to prioritize professions on the fly, directing workers between workshops, farms, and magical ateliers. More control, less chaos!  

✨ Expanding the Game World  
We’re also hard at work expanding the in-game universe: new events, characters, and secrets of the ancient forest await discovery. Soon, you’ll uncover more about this world’s legends and shape its destiny - stay tune for mission 5!

Stay tuned — there’s plenty more magic on the way! 💫  

P.S. Thank you for your feedback and suggestions! Keep sharing your thoughts—it helps us make the game even better.  

Full list of fixes goes like so:

✅ Resolution selection drop-down
✅ Scroll bar now shows percentage
✅ Fixed wheat harvest widget call
✅ Bakery “Cancel/Produce” button works again
✅ Bunkhouse upgrade fixed in Mission 2
✅ Updated character portraits
✅ Fixed Mission 2 restart issue from main menu
✅ Qlipoths now hidden behind trees and buildings

notes.title: The Roadmap: A Major Update for the City-Building Game is in Development
notes.notes:
Dear players and subscribers,  

We are thrilled to announce that work on a major update for our city-building game has reached a new level! Our team has finalized the roadmap that will shape the future development of the project. We are meticulously refining every detail to make the game even more engaging and user-friendly for you.  

What can players expect in the upcoming updates? Svartalfs foraging berries from bushes, new aggressive objects on the map, a new production chain, a new resource—honey, a new mission, and, of course, fixes for the issues you’ve reported. We are confident that these changes will delight both new players and our loyal fans.  

Stay tuned for more news—very soon, we will share details about what exactly will be included in the next update. We are working hard for you and preparing plenty of exciting content!  

Thank you for staying with us. Your support inspires us to keep moving forward!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/ee81dfc9ec05cc441759bc52dfc9a55fa9f334bb.png

Best regards,  
The Elven City Simulator development team.

notes.title: V0.1.021 Road to Release
notes.notes:
Hello there, elves! 

Here is the latest update - v0.1.021, Road to Release.
This is one of the final upcoming updates before the official release. In this version, we’ve tried to close all the gaps in the UI and various mechanics that still needed attention.
Additional informative elements have been added, as well as new functionality for certain buttons. A few bugs have also been fixed. Thanks to everyone who gives feedback, writes comments and supports us by adding the game to the wishlist!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/bbb10bab861cd3361c28aaa801ffc9f3b639012c.jpg

Changes include:


 Baker/Farmer no longer mixed up in logs
 The game is paused after loading
 Progress bars are labeled
 Progress bars for production
 Enchanted trees and bushes emit a bit of light
 Lanterns are now in a separate category
 It's no longer possible to accidentally click more couriers in the tutorial
 Crash due to identical names has been fixed
 The berry now displays the widgets of the elves inside
 You can select something in the counter by double-clicking


Have fun with the demo and don't loose yourself in the fog,
thundercatofdoom and CleDeSol.

notes.title: "Quality of Life" UI update is ready!
notes.notes:
Hello Elfs!

The "Quality of Life" UI Update is now available for everyone!

You will love the new UI that will allow you to build structures easily.

With this new UI system, the information about numbers of elfs, buildings, enchanted trees and missions will be available at any time. So all the newly elements placed on the screen. We are tried to make good their positioning. 

We took a bit more time to fix bugs, but we are completely reworked system for issuing tasks to employees system - demo should goes better!

Also we added a city builder tutorial that include the following information:

Introduction to the game mechanics
Information about User interface
Short help notes in Build menu about all available structures

Now you can move around the map with WASD buttons and hide buildings and trees by pressing X button.

Thanks to everyone supporting us, giving feedback, reviewing the game, and sending us good vibes!

Make your journey into mist!

Full Changelog - v0.1.0 - "Quality of Life" UI Update
Major changes:

New UI for every type - like main menu, pause menu, game elements
New Elfs state. Now they can get tired and should rest in bunkhouses
Wheat now stored in Great Tree (before - in wheat processing)
New sounds for buttons and some game objects
Mini tutorial
Little stories about all the bushes and trees on the map
New Elfs Logistic system

Bug fix:

Fullscreen
Hidden Great Tree position
Game interactive objects are now highlighted correctly

Somes more improvements here & there

We also keep developing our IndieGo Engine - game runs on it. Feel free to report any changes you experienced about the game performances. Next update should receive some quests, new buildings and worker animations, more work on sound design and musical accompaniment.
